title: Norse Atlantic Grounds for Good, FedEx Overshoots at Miami (Again), and Trump's Embraer Tariff Threat
summary: The long-haul budget airline experiment finally runs out of road as Norse Atlantic suspends all flights and stares down bankruptcy. A FedEx freighter overshoots the same Miami runway area that saw a fatal crash just months ago, and Washington's new tariff plan could make your next regional flight a lot more expensive. Plus, United finally starts retiring a 30-year-old workhorse on one of its flagship routes.
